description: Nine entry points, all ON by default with a documented opt-out. SessionStart (compact|resume|clear|startup): control-anchor re-injection (compaction-survival); opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_ANCHOR_HOOKS=0. SessionStart (resume|compact): the stale skill-body check, read from the session transcript; one line per plugin whose last-served skill body came from an older cached version than the installed one, naming both versions and the fix; silent when every body is current or served from outside a plugin cache. Opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_STALE_BODY_CHECK=0. PostToolUse (Write|Edit|MultiEdit): a size warning when a write to an open anchor leaves its HEAD over the injection budget or within 10% of it, plus the self-ignoring .gitignore in the anchors directory; silent on every other write; it shares the SESSION_WORKFLOW_ANCHOR_HOOKS=0 opt-out. Stop: the feedback-debt nudge, read from the session transcript; it stays silent unless a feedback-targets file resolves, so an install with no registered tools never sees it. Opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_FEEDBACK_NUDGE=0. Every no-op path returns zero with no output. See the plugin README for the exact settings block each opt-out goes in. Pending-asks gate (three entry points sharing one script and one switch): UserPromptSubmit empties the per-session ledger (a new turn); PostToolUse on the desktop next-step box tool (mcp__ccd_turn__wrap_up) records the box's question; Stop records the asks in last_assistant_message and, at a stop with nothing in flight, returns additionalContext naming earlier asks of the turn the message dropped, once per ask (never decision: block). Ledger under CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/final-block-gate/. Opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_FINAL_BLOCK_GATE=0; SESSION_WORKFLOW_FINAL_BLOCK_GATE=observe records without output; `python hooks/final_block_gate.py --health` prints the counts. Series guard (two entry points sharing one script and one switch): PostToolUse on Bash|PowerShell records, per session, the repository of a `gh pr create` whose stdout carries a github.com/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<n> URL; PreToolUse on Bash|PowerShell denies a second `gh pr create` in a repository that already holds a recorded PR of the session, unless the command carries KEEL_SERIES=<existing series file or spec> or KEEL_SERIES=none:<reason>. Log under CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/series-guard/. Opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_SERIES_GUARD=0; SESSION_WORKFLOW_SERIES_GUARD=observe logs the would-be deny without output.
